Ese trabajo nos permitió conocer de prim: That work gave us first-hand insight into one of the hardest realities of farming: very often, the person who produces the food has the least control over the value of what they produce.
La rentabilidad de una explotación podía: A farm’s profitability could depend on a good harvest, but also on a selling price the producer did not control. When both went well, it could be a good year. When yields fell or prices dropped, everything changed.
Y en el campo, ningún año está garantiza: And in farming, no year is guaranteed.
En 2017 decidimos buscar una alternativa: In 2017 we decided to look for an alternative for our own produce. We created our first online shop with a simple idea: to reach customers directly and gain greater control over how, and at what price, we sold what we produced.
Los comienzos no fueron fáciles. Apenas: The beginning was not easy. We had very little e-commerce experience and, during the first few years, we had to learn almost everything from scratch.
Pero teníamos algo importante a nuestro: But we had one important thing on our side: we believed in our products.
Poco a poco comenzaron a llegar los prim: Little by little, our first customers arrived. Then came recommendations and repeat orders. We discovered that people valued not only the product itself, but also knowing where it came from and being able to buy it more directly.
Aquella experiencia fue la que terminó d: That experience is what ultimately gave El Mercado de Origen its purpose.
Nos hizo plantearnos una pregunta muy se: It led us to ask a very simple question: if this model had worked for our own products, why couldn’t it work for other producers too?
Así nació la idea de construir un proyec: That is how the idea emerged for a project where origin could once again have the prominence it deserves.
Queremos que detrás de cada producto vue: We want every product to be recognised for what truly gives it value: where it comes from, the work of the person who makes it, and how it is produced.
